metadata.title: Secure Integration

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for enabling secure, accountable, and bounded system-to-system integrations under Zero Trust principles.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Integration platforms, messaging systems, event streams, mediation layers, telemetry pipelines, and trust evaluators.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Composite Zero Trust pattern governing trust propagation, amplification, and revocation across system-to-system integrations.

props.name: data-pattern
props.remarks: Defines system-to-system integration as a trust propagation plane composed of mechanical, semantic, temporal, lifecycle, and aggregate trust signals.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Authoritative control catalog governing non-human access control, auditability, risk evaluation, and system interconnections.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Zero Trust Architecture principles asserting that trust between systems must be explicitly mediated, continuously evaluated, and revocable.

metadata.remarks: Secure Integration composes all integration security patterns into a coherent Zero Trust model. It defines how trust is established, propagated, amplified, constrained, and revoked across system-to-system interactions without granting implicit authorization or business trust.

components.title: Integration Core
components.description: Defines baseline integration eligibility, identity, and trust boundaries.

components.title: Message Security and Integrity
components.description: Provides cryptographic authenticity, integrity, and bounded replay protection.

components.title: Message Queuing
components.description: Defines reliable asynchronous delivery semantics and failure isolation.

components.title: Event Streaming
components.description: Constrains trust amplification and blast radius in publish–subscribe systems.

components.title: Replay and Retention
components.description: Governs time-based trust risks, retention, and replay authorization.

components.title: Schema and Contract Governance
components.description: Prevents semantic over-trust through schema ownership and compatibility governance.

components.title: Service Bus and ESB
components.description: Constrains privilege concentration and mediation risk in centralized integration platforms.

components.title: Integration Lifecycle Signaling
components.description: Emits lifecycle state signals to enable trust degradation and revocation.

components.title: Integration Telemetry Normalization
components.description: Normalizes heterogeneous integration telemetry into decision-grade trust and risk signals.

components.title: Trusted Integration
components.description: Aggregates multiple signals into a bounded, revocable trust assertion.
